# Cleared
> Export document checking for Pakistani exporters — quantities, values, weights, consignee, HS codes and LC terms compared across every document, reviewed by a person before you submit to the bank.

Cleared helps exporters in Pakistan avoid bank document rejections. Upload your PO or LC with the commercial invoice, packing list and bill of lading. An agent extracts fields, a rules engine compares them across documents, and a human reviewer signs off the mismatch report and corrected PDF set. Pay after delivery, with a refund if the corrected set fails our checklist.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://cleared.devs.surf/): Landing page — how Cleared works, pricing tiers, and who joins as it grows.
- [Pricing](https://cleared.devs.surf/pricing.html): Per shipment, Desk, and Partners plans. First three shipments free.
- [Sample report](https://cleared.devs.surf/sample-report.html): A worked mismatch report so visitors see what a mismatch report looks like before sending real documents.
- [Contact](https://cleared.devs.surf/contact.html): WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn contact details.
- [Terms of Service](https://cleared.devs.surf/terms.html): Terms governing use of Cleared.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cleared.devs.surf/privacy.html): How documents and extracted data are collected, used and protected.
- [Refund Policy](https://cleared.devs.surf/refund.html): Pay-after-delivery promise and refund conditions.

## Customer app
- [Create account](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/signup.html): Phone OTP signup — no email password.
- [Log in](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/login.html): Phone OTP login.
- [New shipment](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/new-shipment.html): Upload PO/LC and documents, or forward from WhatsApp or email.
- [Shipment](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/shipment.html): Status, mismatch report and corrected document set download.
- [Saved buyers, products & HS codes](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/saved.html): Repeat shipment shortcuts.
- [Billing](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/billing.html): Free orders left, invoices, bank transfer / JazzCash / Easypaisa / Raast.
- [Team seats](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/team-seats.html): Desk plan staff seats.

## Reviewer console (internal)
- [Review queue](https://cleared.devs.surf/reviewer/queue.html): Shipments waiting for review.
- [Review shipment](https://cleared.devs.surf/reviewer/review.html): Side-by-side documents with agent findings; accept, edit or reject and sign off.

## Admin (internal)
- [Users](https://cleared.devs.surf/admin/users.html): Users, roles and free-order abuse tracking.
- [Orders](https://cleared.devs.surf/admin/orders.html): All shipments and status.
- [Costs](https://cleared.devs.surf/admin/costs.html): Cost per shipment — model usage plus review minutes.
- [Refunds](https://cleared.devs.surf/admin/refunds.html): Refund requests and status.

## Optional reference
- [Payments](https://cleared.devs.surf/app/billing.html): Bank transfer, JazzCash, Easypaisa and Raast payment details.
